# Training-loop governors

Feedback controllers over loop-level knobs, driven by endogenous signals - e.g. ``gns_batch`` governs the gradient-accumulation factor by tracking the measured gradient noise scale.

Registry: ``praxis.GOVERNOR_REGISTRY`` (1 entries)
